privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro_body: At PR Agency, we respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. This policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your information when visiting our website.
privacy.data_1: Technical Information: IP address, browser type, device, operating system.
privacy.data_2: Geographic Information: Country, city, approximate coordinates.
privacy.data_3: Usage Data: Pages visited, time spent, click patterns.
privacy.data_4: Contact Details: Name, email, phone number (upon submitting forms).
privacy.purpose_1: Improving user experience and optimizing our services.
privacy.purpose_2: Responding to inquiries and preparing tailored proposals.
privacy.purpose_3: Analyzing site performance and visitor statistics.
privacy.cookies_body: We use essential cookies to remember language preferences and visitor identifiers for analytics. We do not use third-party cross-site advertising trackers.
privacy.rights_1: The right to access your personal data.
privacy.rights_2: The right to rectify or erase your data.
privacy.rights_3: The right to object to data processing.
privacy.contact_body: For any privacy inquiries, reach us at hello@pragency.ag.
